caption: The audit starts on install: 63% over 28 pages and 26 errors, 24 of them meta tags. A tour and a Schedule a Call banner sit on top. The store name is hidden.
The app's plan table: Free for up to 50 products, Pro at $20 a month for 1,000 products and weekly keyword checks, Pro AI at $45. The store name is hidden.
Shopify's approval screen for Pro asks $20.00 every 30 days, due the same day, with no trial line, and wants a payment method first. We approved nothing. The store name is hidden.
Run AI Optimization wrote a 107 character meta description for a test product and pasted the store name into it. We did not save it. The store name is hidden in the sidebar and the text.
The uninstall dialog says a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete customer data. Uninstall stays greyed out until you pick a reason.
